statements.status_notes: msgpack 1.1.2 is the copy vendored in the pip 26.0.1 wheel that virtualenv 21.15.5 bundles only for Python 3.9. This image runs Python 3.13, and virtualenv selects pip 26.3 for that interpreter. pip 26.3 vendors msgpack 1.2.4, and the application copy is pinned to 1.2.4. https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-114613

msgpack 1.1.2 is the copy vendored in the pip 26.0.1 wheel that virtualenv 21.15.5 bundles only for Python 3.9. This image runs Python 3.13, and virtualenv selects pip 26.3 for that interpreter. pip 26.3 vendors msgpack 1.2.4, and the application copy is pinned to 1.2.4. https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-114613
Alias of CVE-2026-57585. pip vendors msgpack 1.1.2 without the vulnerable _cmsgpack C extension; only the pure-Python fallback is present under pip/_vendor/msgpack.

pip's vendored msgpack is the pure-Python fallback only (fallback.py, ext.py, exceptions.py). CVE-2026-57585 is a use-after-free in the Cython _cmsgpack extension; pip does not ship that native module and always falls back to the pure-Python implementation.
